_note: Seconds of stoppage per event (ADR-026). water_break 180 (ADR-068): FIFA's cooling break, three minutes, added to the half's time. goal_to_kick_off_s (SIM 150, BEHAVIOURS.md 27): measured, the median time from a goal to the next kick-off in Serie A 2017-18 (Wyscout soccer-logs, Pappalardo and Massucco 2019, figshare doi:10.6084/m9.figshare.c.4415000, CC BY 4.0; 1009 goals, quartiles 53.0 and 70.4 s; the first season with VAR, whose checks lengthen the mean, 66.1 s, so the median). After a goal the players walk back to their half and the kick-off is taken no sooner; it is also the longest the referee waits for any restart, so that a man pinned by another body never stops the match. duel 10 -> 0 (2026-11-12): a clean duel does not stop play; the time is lost to fouls, goals, injuries. With the duel in the match (SIM_VERSION 47) thousands of duels made a 328-minute match.
